goal: Allow local RPC and REST connections and bitcoin-cli over UNIX domain sockets
Lets node operators manage access via filesystem permissions rather than IP allowlists
Eliminates TCP loopback overhead for local node communication
agreement: Approach approval citing clean design with socket variants and high user demand (winterrdog)
Earlier concerns regarding socket file collisions and Host header regressions were fixed (b-l-u-e)
Open question on whether to support abstract namespace sockets in the future (winterrdog)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fulfills a long-standing user request for UNIX domain socket RPC support
Provides filesystem-based access control and removes TCP loopback overhead for node operators
